en: Conditioned by a state that is neither with initial application nor sustained application and is not wholesome, a state that is with initial application and sustained application and is wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Fifteen in the case of root; ... pe ... fifteen in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither with initial application nor sustained application and is not unwholesome, a state that is with initial application and sustained application and is unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is with applied thought and sustained thought and is not indeterminate, there arises a state that is without applied thought and without sustained thought and is indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are seven [conditions] under root; seven under predominance … pe … seven under non-disappearance.
